# @zakkster/lite-depth v1.4.0

Zero-GC Canvas2D software-projected 3D. Zdog's niche (flat-shaded, painter-sorted
pseudo-3D on a 2D canvas), arena-backed and allocation-free per frame. Single-file
ESM. Node/browser. MIT. Author: Zahary Shinikchiev.

Runtime deps: @zakkster/lite-arena, @zakkster/lite-fastbit32, @zakkster/lite-aabb.
Optional cold-path peers: lite-signal (DI), lite-raf, lite-clock, lite-sprite-cache.

## Model

- A Stage owns an arena of nodes (SoA, generational handles), a pre-allocated
  frame arena, and a Canvas2D ctx. Geometries and materials are registered once
  and referenced by id; nodes instance them.
- stage.frame(dt) runs: transform -> project -> collect+cull -> radix sort ->
  paint. Entirely over pre-allocated storage: 0 alloc/frame. Structural mutation
  (add/remove/reparent) is cold and may allocate.
- Painter's algorithm: no depth buffer. Faces sorted back-to-front by a packed
  Uint32 key: (layer<<26) | quantize26(centroidViewZ + depthBias). Far -> key 0
  (painted first), near -> DEPTH_MAX (painted last).

## Import

    import { createStage, geometry, material, materialFromRamp,
             createCamera, updateCamera, mathKernels, FLAGS, TAU, version }
      from '@zakkster/lite-depth';

## createStage(ctx, opts) -> Stage

opts: { width, height, dpr, maxNodes, maxVerts, maxDrawFaces, camera }
- maxVerts = TOTAL projected vertices across all visible instances per frame
  (sphere(_,10,6) = 77 verts, box = 8). Undersizing silently drops geometry.
- maxDrawFaces = total draw-face budget per frame.
- camera: { fov, near, far, ortho, orthoScale, theta, phi, radius,
  targetX/Y/Z }.

## Geometry (register with stage.geometry(g) -> id)

    geometry.box(w=1,h=1,d=1)              // 8 verts, 6 QUAD faces
    geometry.plane(w=1,d=1)                // 4 verts, 1 face
    geometry.sphere(r=0.5, segU=12, segV=8)
    geometry.cylinder(r=0.5, h=1, seg=16)
    geometry.cone(r=0.5, h=1, seg=16)
    geometry.polyline(points)              // flat xyz array; kind='stroke', F=0
    geometry.custom(verts, faces)          // verts flat xyz; faces = index loops
Geometry fields: V, F, verts(Float32), faceVertOffset(Uint32,len F+1),
faceVerts(Uint32), faceNormal(Float32), radius, kind ('fill'|'stroke').
Quads/n-gons first-class. Normals via Newell's method.

## Material (register with stage.material(m) -> id)

    material({ r=90,g=200,b=120, ambient=0.35, steps=64, stroke=null,
               lineWidth=2, fill=true })   // bakes a K-step hex ramp
    materialFromRamp(hexRamp, { stroke, lineWidth, fill })  // e.g. lite-hueforge scale
Per-frame shade is one LUT index, baked into the shade lane during collect and
read once by paint: lut[shade]. No per-frame string build, no per-face normal math
in the paint loop.
K CAP: steps (and a materialFromRamp ramp length) is capped at 256 -- the per-frame
shade lane is a Uint8Array, so an index must fit 0..255. A larger ramp THROWS at
creation (fail closed, did-you-mean hint) rather than silently wrapping to step 0.
fill=false: the face is NOT filled (honoured since v1.4.0; before, fill:false still
filled). stroke set: the face OUTLINE is stroked in the same style-run batch --
fill:false + stroke gives a wireframe; fill:true + stroke gives fill-then-outline.

## Nodes (Stage methods; h = generational NodeHandle)

    h = stage.addNode(geomId, matId, { x, y, z, layer, parent })
    stage.setPosition(h, x, y, z)
    stage.setScale(h, x, y?, z?)           // uniform if y/z omitted
    stage.setQuaternion(h, x, y, z, w)
    stage.setEuler(h, ex, ey, ez)          // XYZ, radians
    stage.setParent(h, parentHandle)       // 0/undefined = root; cold topo rebuild
    stage.setLayer(h, 0..63)               // high bits of the sort key
    stage.setDepthBias(h, bias)            // added to viewZ before quantize (popping fix)
    stage.setVisible(h, bool)
    stage.remove(h)                        // generational: stale handle invalidates
    stage.resize(w, h, dpr?)
Stale handles after remove() are safe: isAlive(h) is false, never aliases a
recycled slot.

## Lifecycle (cold path; scene reload / capacity growth)

    stage.clear()             // remove all nodes in place, keep capacity/geometry/
                              // material/camera/arenas; 0 alloc; returns stage.
                              // EVERY handle minted before clear() is invalid after.
    stage.reserve(n)          // grow all node-capacity lanes to n; false if
                              // n<=capacity, true after grow; throws on bad arg.
    stage.remainingNodes      // getter: free node slots (capacity - live count)
    stage.structureEpoch      // getter: Uint32, bumped by addNode/remove/setParent/
                              // clear. Invalidation signal for cached dense indices.
A parent handle that is dead/recycled when topology rebuilds reparents its child
to ROOT and bumps stats.nodesOrphaned (fail closed, never inherits a stranger's
matrix). A parent CYCLE throws from the cold topo rebuild, naming both nodes.

## Frame + stats

    const s = stage.frame(dt);
    // s = { facesDrawn, facesCulled, nodesCulled, drawCalls,
    //       tTransform, tProject, tSort, tPaint,          (ms for the t* fields)
    //       facesOverflowed,   // nodes skipped by the vert/draw-face overflow door
    //       nodesInvalid,      // nodes rejected by the fail-closed collect door:
    //                          // a non-finite (NaN/Inf) pose lane, centroid, radius
    //                          // or bias -> whole node skipped, never laundered
    //       nodesNonUniform,   // drawn nodes with a non-uniform LOCAL scale (flag);
    //                          // inherited-only descendants are shaded via the
    //                          // inverse-transpose too but are not counted here
    //       nodesOrphaned,     // nodes whose dead parent forced a ROOT reparent
    //       nodesTotal }       // live node count this frame

## Camera

    updateCamera(stage.camera)             // cold; rebuild world->view after mutating
    stage.camera.theta/phi/radius/tx/ty/tz/fov/near/far/ortho/orthoScale
Interaction (drag/pinch/inertia) is NOT in core — wire pointer events to
theta/phi/radius + updateCamera yourself, or use a companion driver.
stage.view2d (Float64Array[6] or null): optional per-frame setTransform — the
2D screen-space camera composition hook over the 3D scene.

## lite-signal DI (cold path)

    import { effect } from '@zakkster/lite-signal';
    stage.useSignals({ effect });
    stage.bind(h, 'position'|'scale'|'quaternion', () => signalGetter());
Effect writes lanes + marks dirty on the cold path; frame loop only reads lanes.

## Light

stage.light is a normalized Float64Array[3] directional light. Flat per-face
shading = clamp(dot(worldNormal, light), 0, 1), ambient floor from the material.
worldNormal is derived from the node's WORLD matrix (the same transform the
geometry is drawn from), NOT the local quaternion -- so a child of a rotated /
scaled parent is lit correctly (fixed in v1.4.0; before, hierarchical scenes were
mis-lit). Mechanics, computed ONCE per node in collect:
  - Uniform world basis (a similarity): the light is back-rotated into the
    geometry's local frame, and each face is a single sqrt-free dot with its
    precomputed local normal.
  - Non-uniform world basis: the normal matrix (inverse-transpose / adjugate of the
    world upper-3x3) is built once, and each face does normal*matrix, normalize,
    dot. This path is selected by a per-node WORLD non-uniform bit that propagates
    down the hierarchy in topo order (own non-uniform local scale OR any
    non-uniform ancestor -- rotation is a similarity and does NOT taint), so an
    inherited non-uniform scale is handled correctly.
The shade is baked into a per-draw shade lane during collect; paint() reads that
lane -- no per-face normal math. stats.nodesNonUniform counts drawn nodes with a
non-uniform LOCAL scale (the flag); inherited-only descendants are shaded via the
inverse-transpose but are not themselves counted.

## Math kernels (out-param, no classes; affine 3x4 row-major)

    mathKernels.composeTRS(out12, tx,ty,tz, qx,qy,qz,qw, sx,sy,sz)
    mathKernels.mulAffine(out12, A12, B12)     // out = A*B (parent*local)
    mathKernels.quatRotate(out3, qx,qy,qz,qw, vx,vy,vz)

## Gotchas

- maxVerts/maxDrawFaces must cover the worst-case VISIBLE scene; sphere verts are
  (segU+1)*(segV+1). Undersizing is now fail-closed: an over-budget node is
  SKIPPED whole (two integer compares per node) and stats.facesOverflowed counts
  it -- no out-of-range write, no partial face. Size up when facesOverflowed > 0.
- Back-face cull uses screen winding; DOUBLE_SIDED flag disables it per node.
- Depth key: far->0, near->DEPTH_MAX. depthBias shifts a node earlier/later.
- Zero-alloc applies to frame(); creation/reconfiguration is cold and may allocate.
- Verifying zero-GC: use @zakkster/lite-gc-profiler and await gc.settle() before
  reading the summary — the perf_hooks GC observer delivers asynchronously.

## Motion subpath — @zakkster/lite-depth/motion (v1.3.0)

Optional animation layer. Thin composer over the stack: lite-clock (time base),
lite-keyframe KeyframePool (scalar channels), lite-ease (easing bank). Adds only
quaternion slerp tracks + a clip table bound to node lanes. Optional peer deps:
lite-clock, lite-keyframe, lite-ease (install only if you import this subpath).

    import { createMixer } from '@zakkster/lite-depth/motion';
    const mixer = createMixer(stage, { clock, maxClips, maxKeys, easings });

createMixer(stage, opts) -> Mixer
  opts: { clock?, maxClips=256, maxKeys=8, maxQuatKeys=8, easings? }
  clock: a lite-clock (duck-typed via clock.simTime). Omit for standalone dt mode.
  easings: array of lite-ease function names; index 0 should be 'linear'. Names
           become the ids used by the `ease` argument on *Key calls.

mixer.clip(nodeHandle) -> Clip   (chainable; all keys take time in SECONDS)
  clip.posKey(t, x, y, z, ease?)
  clip.scaleKey(t, s, ease?)                 // uniform
  clip.scaleKey(t, x, y, z, ease?)           // per-axis (string in an axis slot = ease)
  clip.biasKey(t, v, ease?)                  // depth-bias
  clip.quatKey(t, x, y, z, w, ease?)         // slerp (nlerp fast path at dot>0.9995)
  clip.quatEuler(t, ex, ey, ez, ease?)       // XYZ Euler radians -> quat
  clip.play({ duration?, loop?, timescale?, start? })
       duration inferred from last key if omitted; loop: 'loop'|'pingpong'|number
  clip.pause() / resume() / stop() / seek(localSeconds)
  clip.done / clip.playing

mixer.update(dt)  // standalone: advance internal time by dt, then apply
mixer.sync()      // clock mode: apply at clock.simTime (call after clock.advance)
mixer.time / mixer.clipCount
exports: createMixer, ONCE, LOOP, PINGPONG, version

Time base / determinism: in clock mode global pause/seek/replay live on the clock;
fixed advance(dt) gives golden-frame determinism (byte-identical lanes). The update
path is allocation-free (channels write straight into Float64 lanes; 0 GC over
20000 ops, gated on bytes/op not scavenge count).

Motion gotchas:
- Keyframe times are ABSOLUTE seconds within the clip, not normalized [0,1].
- scaleKey uniform-with-ease: pass the ease as the 3rd arg, e.g.
  scaleKey(t, 1.5, 'easeOutCubic') — a string in an axis slot is read as the ease.
- Quaternion keyframe values are stored Float32 (slerp math is bit-exact; the
  ~1e-7 delta vs a Float64 reference is storage precision, not error).

## Test / bench

    npm test          # node:test (6 files: core 01/03/04, motion 06/07/09);
                      # both zero-GC tests skip without --expose-gc
    npm run test:gc   # --expose-gc; zero-GC contracts engage
    npm run torture   # node --expose-gc test/torture.mjs -> prints "ok" (zero-GC gate)
    npm run bench     # vs Zdog + throughput sweep
